description: A playable text-adventure CV game: explore the career of Mike "Demo" Demopoulos — partnerships and technology leader — across eight rooms (career stops at hosting.com, Codeable, InMotion Hosting/BoldGrid, Joomla, Forbes Agency Council, plus projects and education). Type commands like LOOK, GO NORTH, EXAMINE, and TAKE to read career details and collect all 8 artifacts to win.
name: mike-demo-cv

skills.description: Guides a human player through the interactive terminal game at https://mikedemo.work using real in-game commands: LOOK, GO <direction> (N/S/E/W/UP/DOWN), EXAMINE <object>, TAKE <artifact>, MAP, CONTACT, RESUME, and HELP.
skills.name: Play the CV Adventure

skills.description: Summarizes the eight career rooms of the CV adventure: The Atrium (summary), The Cloud Deck (hosting.com Partnerships Lead), The Partner Guild (Codeable Head of Partnerships), The Treasury (Joomla board/fundraising), The Evangelist's Forge (InMotion Hosting/BoldGrid), The Workshop (AI projects and community), The Academy (education and certifications), and The Council Chamber (Forbes Agency Council).
skills.name: Read Career Rooms

skills.description: Shares Mike Demopoulos's public contact channels (email, phone, LinkedIn, personal site) for hiring or partnership inquiries.
skills.name: Contact Demo
